title: Caveman
statement: The task is to count red/blue colorings of an undirected graph (n, m up to 3·10^5) in which every vertex has a neighbor of the opposite color, reporting 0, 1, 2 or many. Swapping colors pairs colorings, so 1 never occurs; an isolated vertex forces zero, a spanning tree's bipartition otherwise always works, and exactly two arise only when the graph is a star, so vertex degrees decide it.
